mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_session WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS sessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','WAITING_USER')) AS openTicketCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faq_item WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED') AS publishedFaqCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manual_doc WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED') AS publishedManualCount
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ticket WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ticket WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= UTC_DATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day
